stream_sum(tree, column, threshold, weight, chunk_entries): Return sumw where column > threshold, reading chunk_entries rows per chunk.
check_counts(tree, column, count, id_column): Return IDs where count differs from per-row length of collection column.
write_skim(tree, column, threshold, id_column): Write new Selected TTree with id_column and column where column > threshold; reopen and return class and IDs.
write_hist(tree, column, edges): Write new unweighted histogram of column with edges, reopen and return values and edges.
